title: Deliverable manifest
description: The deliverables a campaign will produce, written by campaign-brief and consumed by the expansion phase. An entry is either an ASSET (one entry, one artifact, one expander) or a PIPELINE (one entry that an owning multi-step pipeline fans out into many artifacts, e.g. the ads funnel). campaign-brief must not enumerate the assets a pipeline owns. Author as YAML and validate the parsed object against this schema. Extra keys tolerated.

brand.description: Brand id, matches brands/<id>/. THE authoritative brand link: skills resolve the pack to brands/<brand>/pack.yaml by reading this, never by parsing the campaign folder's <brand>- prefix. See schema/campaign-structure.md section 1.1.

id.description: Unique slug within the campaign. For asset entries it becomes the media/<id>/ folder name and artifact filename stem per schema/campaign-structure.md; for pipeline entries it names the pipeline run (the pipeline registers its sub-ids in the generation log).

kind.description: asset = one entry, one artifact, one expander. pipeline = one entry an owning skill fans out into many artifacts.

skill.description: Asset entries: the expander skill that produces this, e.g. personal-post, customer-story, email-newsletter, landing-page, visual-ideas, compose-lockup.

pipeline.description: Pipeline entries: the pipeline that owns the fan-out, e.g. "ads" (ad-creative -> video-ad-script -> generate-video).

channel.description: Asset entries: channel id from the pack.

format.description: Asset entries: format within the channel.

channels.description: Pipeline entries: channels the pipeline should cover. The pipeline decides the concrete assets.

funnel_stage.description: Asset entries: stage in the brand's vocabulary.

funnel_stages.description: Pipeline entries: stages the pipeline should span, e.g. [Reach, Trust, Sell].

audience_ref.description: Audience segment id from the pack.

offer_ref.description: Product id from the pack this promotes.

tagline_variant.description: Which tagline from message.md this uses, if several.

sizes.description: Asset entries: size/ratio variants to output.
